Projects.Name: AWS.Logger.Core
ChangelogMessages: Fix PutLogEvents batch-size accounting to use real UTF-8 byte counts plus the 26-byte-per-event CloudWatch overhead, and enforce the 1,048,576-byte and 10,000-event per-batch service limits. Previously batch size was estimated with Encoding.Unicode.GetMaxByteCount (roughly 2x the real UTF-8 size for ASCII/JSON payloads), so bursts were split into about twice as many PutLogEvents calls as necessary.
